text:
Priya S: Quick design review — prompt sets approval flow. I pushed the Figma link, want quick calls on copy/buttons and the regression diff compact view. :wave:

Marco L: Link? can you paste it here? also: we need a keyboard-first flow for approvers, not just mouse.

Priya S: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd123/prompt-sets-approval (mock)

Jason H: Copy nit: current CTA is "Approve eval" which feels ambiguous. Suggest: "Approve and promote" or "Approve → Active". Short is good for buttons.

Alice M: +1 to making CTA explicit. Also need confirmation modal text to include what changes will be promoted. Eg:
```
Are you sure you want to approve 4 tests and promote them to the active suite?
This action will make these prompts used in production evaluations.
[Cancel] [Approve and promote]
```

Marco L: For accessibility: modal must trap focus and the primary CTA needs aria-descriptive text. Also diff images need alt text. Design-Bot, can we auto-generate alt like "Diff snapshot for suite X at 2026-01-15"?

Design-Bot: Automated diff uploaded: https://storage.company/diffs/1770139024-snapshot.png. Alt suggestion: "Regression diff for Prompt set 'checkout-bot' — +2 regressions, -1 improvement" :robot_face:

Emily K: On the scorecard layout: can we collapse unchanged rows to reduce noise? Maybe a compact 'show only regressions' toggle defaulted off but saved per-user.

Jason H: Yes, a toggle is perfect. Also add a small delta chip next to model names: e.g., "-3.2%" in red or green depending on sign.

Priya S: UX question: do we include a required approval count (two approvals) or make owner override possible? Legal wants an audit trail so maybe two approvers unless owner explicitly bypasses.

Alice M: Add an inline audit line: "Approved by X on <date> — reason: <optional>". Make reason required if override used.

Marco L: One more: regression diffs can be heavy to load. Can we show a lightweight textual summary first, then lazy-load image previews? Keeps perf good for mobile.

Design-Bot: Added lightweight summary card in Figma -> frame 'diff-summary-compact'. Pinging @Priya S to review.

Priya S: Thanks — can we also tweak copy in the scorecard header: replace "Overall Score" with "Quality Score" — product asked for that wording.

Emily K: Accessibility nit: color contrast for delta chips currently fails AA for red on dark background. Use patterns or icons plus color.

Jason H: I'll add keyboard shortcuts: 'A' to approve when modal focused, 'P' to toggle show-only-regressions.

Priya S: Cool. Plan: Marco to update Figma with keyboard states, Alice to write modal copy, Jason to prototype shortcut, Emily to run a11y check, Design-Bot will re-upload diff snapshots. Follow-up sync tomorrow 10am. :calendar:

Marco L: Sounds good. I'll add the alt text generator to the export script.

Alice M: Will do copy PR after Figma update.

Design-Bot: Noted. CI will attach diff metadata to the thread automatically after next run.

Emily K: tiny follow-up — can we make the approval button size 44px min for touch targets? mobile folks will thank us.

Priya S: Added to the ticket. Thanks all :heart:
